title: Audience Evidence
description: A compact product-level audience-composition claim. Audience evidence supports planning and ranking only: it never implies user-level targeting capability or legal age verification.

dimension.description: Evidence dimension. Age is the first standardized dimension.

age.description: Age range whose share of the product audience is estimated. include_unknown is always false because unknown-age users are outside the numeric numerator.

estimated_share.description: Estimated fraction of the full product audience in the age range, from 0 to 1. The denominator includes users whose age is unknown; the numeric age range numerator does not.

verification_methods.description: Methods used to establish the underlying user-level ages. Required when basis is verified and invalid for every other basis. A method name alone is not proof that the product supports per-impression execution.

provider.description: Optional provider responsible for the evidence claim. Omit when the seller is the implicit provider.
